messages:
Lena Park: FYI customers PO failed to publish to CloudMarket. Error says billing_account_unlinked. @Devin can you triage?

marketplace-bot: ALERT: PO publish_error id=CM-PO-6710 code=billing_account_unlinked detail="no active billing mapping for buyer_id: acme-retail-co"

Devin Lee: Checking. Which portal vendor is referenced and which legal entity signed the SOW?

Lena Park: Portal vendor: vendor_12011. SOW signed by Acme Retail Co (billing id acme-retail-co). Portal vendor primary billing is acme-parent-holdings.

Priya Nair: Contracts: we need customer confirmation to accept invoices addressed to the parent. If not, we must add a billing alias on vendor_12011.

Devin Lee: I tried to add alias via Admin UI but Save is disabled (Org role). Will open support ticket and request marketplace-ops to apply a temporary alias.

marketplace-bot: Ticket MKP-4722 created: alias request vendor_12011 -> acme-retail-co. Assigned marketplace-ops.

Priya Nair: Contracts approves a temporary alias if Lena attaches the customer's written confirmation.

Lena Park: Attached email to MKP-4722. Customer confirms invoices to acme-retail-co.

marketplace-bot: MKP-4722 update: alias applied temporarily for vendor_12011 -> acme-retail-co (expires 30 days).

Devin Lee: Re-running publish...

marketplace-bot: PO publish succeeded: CM-PO-6710 -> PUBLISHED ext_id: ext-CM-6710-1

Lena Park: Customer confirmed invoice received. Closing loop.

Priya Nair: Follow-up: Contracts will prepare a one-page amendment template for alias approvals. Also recommend RBAC change so marketplace-oncall can add aliases without tickets.

Devin Lee: Filing onboarding checklist item to verify vendor.billing_id vs SOW.billing_id pre-publish (ONB-1166).

Lena Park: Thanks all.
